description: This file defines functions and types related to chat channel metadata, including building a record of chat channels by ID based on plugin metadata.

methods.name: toChatChannelMeta
methods.description: Converts plugin channel parameters into a ChatChannelMeta object, validating and trimming labels and other properties.

methods.name: buildChatChannelMetaById
methods.description: Builds and returns a frozen record mapping ChatChannelId to ChatChannelMeta by processing plugin metadata.
